title: Sorceress Casting Vortex Spell
description: A blonde female sorceress in ornate white and gold attire floats dynamically in the center of a swirling magical vortex. She holds a glowing blue staff aloft in her right hand while channeling a swirling pink and blue portal with her left, surrounded by dark shadowy figures being drawn into the turbulent magical currents against a dramatic red and dark cloudy sky.
